name: traveler-v1
chrf_floor_note: Calibrated from the NEU-61 kickoff sweep: measured corpus chrF 76.8 on the published v2.0.0 pack; floor = max(15.0, min(0.45 * chrF, chrF - 20)). A direction-mislabeled pack collapses far below this value (see the es-en adversarial control).

entries.source: I need 3 tickets for tomorrow morning.
entries.reference: Vajan 3 piletit homseks hommikuks.

entries.source: There are 5 of us, including 2 children.
entries.reference: Meid on 5, sealhulgas 2 last.

entries.source: My phone number is 0044 7788 123456.
entries.reference: Minu telefoninumber on 0044 7788 123456.

entries.source: The flight takes 9 hours and 25 minutes.
entries.reference: Lend kestab 9 tundi ja 25 minutit.

entries.source: We are 4 people and we have 6 suitcases.
entries.reference: Meid on 4 inimest ja meil on 6 kohvrit.

entries.source: Room 214 is on the second floor.
entries.reference: Tuba 214 asub teisel korrusel.

entries.source: I arrived on October 3 and I leave on October 9.
entries.reference: Saabusin 3. oktoobril ja lahkun 9. oktoobril.

entries.source: What time does the museum open on Sundays?
entries.reference: Mis kell avaneb muuseum pühapäeviti?

entries.source: My train leaves at 18:45 from platform 7.
entries.reference: Minu rong väljub kell 18:45 perroonilt 7.

entries.source: The last bus leaves at 23:30 tonight.
entries.reference: Viimane buss väljub kell 23:30 täna õhtul.

entries.source: I have a reservation at 8 pm for 2 people.
entries.reference: Mul on broneering kell 20 õhtul 2 inimesele.

entries.source: Does the pharmacy open before 9 in the morning?
entries.reference: Kas apteek avaneb enne kella 9 hommikul?

entries.source: The tour starts at 14:15 and lasts 3 hours.
entries.reference: Üritus algab kell 14:15 ja kestab 3 tundi.

entries.source: Breakfast is served from 6:30 to 10:00.
entries.reference: Hommikusööki serveeritakse kella 6:30-st kuni 10:00-ni.

entries.source: How much is a double room for 3 nights?
entries.reference: Kui palju maksab kaheinimesetuba 3 ööks?

entries.source: This costs 45 euros, including tax.
entries.reference: See maksab 45 eurot, sealhulgas maksud.

entries.source: Is there a discount for 2 adults and 1 child?
entries.reference: Kas on allahindlust 2 täiskasvanule ja 1 lapsele?

entries.source: The ticket costs 12.50 euros per person.
entries.reference: Pilet maksab 12,50 eurot inimese kohta.

entries.source: Can I pay the 78 euros by card?
entries.reference: Kas ma saan 78 eurot kaardiga maksta?

entries.source: How much is the airport shuttle for 2 people?
entries.reference: Kui palju maksab lennujaama buss 2 inimesele?

entries.source: The menu of the day is 15 euros with a drink included.
entries.reference: Päevamenüü maksab 15 eurot koos joogiga.

entries.source: The address is Calle Mayor 15, third floor.
entries.reference: Aadress on Calle Mayor 15, kolmas korrus.

entries.source: My hotel is at 28 Gran Vía, near the metro.
entries.reference: Minu hotell asub aadressil Gran Vía 28, metroo lähedal.

entries.source: The embassy is at Paseo de la Castellana 259.
entries.reference: Suursaatkond asub aadressil Paseo de la Castellana 259.

entries.source: Please write down the address: number 42, apartment 5B.
entries.reference: Palun kirjutage aadress üles: number 42, korter 5B.

entries.source: The meeting point is Plaza del Sol, gate 3.
entries.reference: Kohalejäämispunkt on Plaza del Sol, värav 3.

entries.source: Is this the way to Carrer de Balmes 112?
entries.reference: Kas see on tee Carrer de Balmes 112 juurde?

entries.source: Where is the nearest bus stop?
entries.reference: Kus on lähim bussipeatus?

entries.source: Turn left at the traffic lights, then go straight for 200 meters.
entries.reference: Pöörake fooride juures vasakule ja siis minge 200 meetrit otse.

entries.source: Is the station within walking distance of the hotel?
entries.reference: Kas jaamast saab hotelli jalutada?

entries.source: Which line goes to the airport, line 5 or line 8?
entries.reference: Milline liin sõidab lennujaama, liin 5 või liin 8?

entries.source: Excuse me, is this seat 14A?
entries.reference: Vabandust, kas see on koht 14A?

entries.source: How do I get to the old town from here?
entries.reference: Kuidas ma siit vanalinna saan?

entries.source: The museum is about 15 minutes on foot from the square.
entries.reference: Muuseum on väljakust umbes 15 minutilise jalutuskäigu kaugusel.

entries.source: Please call an ambulance, someone is unconscious.
entries.reference: Palun kutsuge kiirabi, keegi on teadvuseta.

entries.source: I have lost my passport and my wallet.
entries.reference: Ma kaotasin oma passi ja rahakoti.

entries.source: Where is the nearest hospital or clinic?
entries.reference: Kus on lähim haigla või kliinik?

entries.source: I am allergic to peanuts; does this dish contain any?
entries.reference: Olen maapähkli suhtes allergiline; kas see roog sisaldab neid?

entries.source: Someone stole my bag with 200 euros inside.
entries.reference: Keegi varastas minu koti, milles oli 200 eurot.

entries.source: Call the police, please. There has been an accident.
entries.reference: Kutsuge politsei, palun. On juhtunud õnnetus.
